attr.title: Ark Hero
attr.desc: A guitar rhythm game that plays the songs made by the Clone Hero community (.chart or .mid charts with ogg, opus, mp3 or wav audio). Up to 4 players on the built-in controls, USB controllers, USB guitars or a keyboard, in controller mode or guitar mode (frets + strum), with star power, whammy, sustains and HOPOs. Practice mode loops a section at 50 to 100% speed.
attr.inst: Ready to run. No songs are included: copy Clone Hero song folders into ports/arkhero/songs/. Without songs, the Demo entry plays sample notes with a metronome.
